citation.authors: Menon A, Jalal A, Arshad Z, Nawaz FA et al

cited_by.title: Lion's mane and reishi mushroom supplements

record.population: Humans and laboratory models: five randomised trials, three pilot trials, one cohort study and a case report on lion's mane, plus 15 laboratory studies
record.design: Systematic review of lion's mane as a supplement (benefits and side effects)
record.finding: The authors report cognitive benefits in the trials, including a combined Mini-Mental State Examination gain of about 1 point. Side effects are commonly unreported; those that were reported include stomach discomfort, headache and allergic reactions.
record.note: A very small evidence base, mostly in people with cognitive problems. Ethnicity not described in the abstract.
